With tech-enabled living, and health and well-being intrinsic to what we do, this is renting like never before. Deposit alternative available, fuss-free living, pet-friendly homes in the heart of Leeds cultural quarter. Not just bespoke interior designed apartments, but also state-of-the-art amenities including private dining room, residents lounge, co-working spaces, media room, 24-hour gym and two rooftop BBQ terrace. 

So what are you waiting for? Reserve your new Moda home in Leeds NOW

YOUR APARTMENT
*	1 x master bedroom with en-suite bathroom and rainfall shower 
*	1 x spacious second bedroom
*	1 x bedroom perfect for flexibility of home office or child's bedroom
*	House bathroom with rainfall shower and separate deluxe bath
*	Open plan living with 3-seater and 2-seater sofas
*	Fitted kitchen with dining space for six
*	Floor to ceiling windows with views towards Leeds City Centre

YOUR KITCHEN
Open plan, sleek and modern with quartz worktops and integrated appliances including touch control, ceramic, 4-ring induction hob, oven, microwave, stacked fridge and freezer and dishwasher. Additional washer/ dryer within utility cupboard. Room to entertain with a dining table in marble effect and six chairs.

YOUR LIVING AREA
Light and spacious with stylish herringbone blackout curtains. Plush three-seater and two-seater sofas, media storage unit and small and large coffee tables with mirrored tops.

YOUR BEDROOMS
Stylish bedrooms including bespoke fitted wardrobes with full height mirror, hanging rail and storage. Ottoman beds with storage, feature headboard and 1,000 individual pocket sprung mattress made from natural materials and marble effect bedside tables. 

YOUR BATHROOMS
Contemporary design and with porcelain tiling throughout. En-suite with deluxe sized rainfall shower with separate handheld shower, WC and heated towel rail, plus bespoke vanity cabinet with LED lighting. Additional house bathroom with both shower and separate full-sized, deluxe bath. Both with WC and heated towel rail, plus bespoke vanity cabinet with LED lighting.


Council Tax Band: E

Please note that utilities (including electricity, water, and heating, depending on your apartment), council tax, TV licence, parking (if required), and any optional extras or upgraded services are not included within your monthly rent.
